programme.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (1968)
programme.desc: A weird inventor, Caractacus Potts, invents an amazing flying car, which drives by itself. It takes him and his Family to Vulgaria, where the sinister buffoon Baron Bomburst kidnaps the car.

programme.title: The Sterile Cuckoo
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, an eccentric girl forces a college love affair with a reluctant student. Nominated for 2 Academy Awards including Best Song "Come Saturday Morning."

programme.title: Wake Of The Red Witch
programme.desc: In the 1800's, an East Indies shipping tycoon and the swash-buckling captain of a trading vessel, The Red Witch, battle for gold, priceless pearls, and the love of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Secret Service agent Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack and works to rescue the President from his kidnappers.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Mimic

programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: The Sun Is Also A Star
programme.desc: The Sun Is Also a Star is an epic romance about two teenagers (Charles Melton and Yara Shahidi), who meet —and fall for each other—on one fateful day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City as Natasha fights against her family’s deportation.

programme.title: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Action-packed and full of fun, set off on a wacky adventure with kung-fu fighting cousins Thomas and David whose simple life running a fast-food van in Spain is turned upside down by the beautiful pickpocket Sylvia.

programme.title: The Protector

programme.title: Airplane!

programme.title: The Sterile Cuckoo
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, an eccentric girl forces a college love affair with a reluctant student. Nominated for 2 Academy Awards including Best Song "Come Saturday Morning."

programme.title: Wake Of The Red Witch
programme.desc: In the 1800's, an East Indies shipping tycoon and the swash-buckling captain of a trading vessel, The Red Witch, battle for gold, priceless pearls, and the love of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Yours, Mine and Ours
programme.desc: When widowed nurse Helen North (Lucille Ball) meets widower Frank Beardsley (Henry Fonda), a population explosion takes place as her eight kids blend (or don't) with his ten in this chaotic, classic comedy! Van Johnson and Tom Bosley co-star.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: The Sun Is Also A Star
programme.desc: The Sun Is Also a Star is an epic romance about two teenagers (Charles Melton and Yara Shahidi), who meet —and fall for each other—on one fateful day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City as Natasha fights against her family’s deportation.

programme.title: The Sun Is Also A Star
programme.desc: The Sun Is Also a Star is an epic romance about two teenagers (Charles Melton and Yara Shahidi), who meet —and fall for each other—on one fateful day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City as Natasha fights against her family’s deportation.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
programme.desc: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

programme.title: Operation Condor
programme.desc: Jackie Chan ignites the big screen as the world's greatest secret agent, code name Condor. Sent to track down stolen Nazi gold, he is pursued by a ruthless band of treasure-hunting terrorists on a globe-spanning quest to reach the bounty first!

programme.title: Operation Condor II: The Armour Of The Gods
programme.desc: Jackie Chan is a fortune hunter whose ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil cult! Things kick into high gear when her fiancée, an old friend of Jackie’s, asks him for help in securing the kidnappers’ lone demand: the priceless Armor of The Gods!

programme.title: Mr. Mom
programme.desc: Michael Keaton plays a husband and father who loses his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant. After struggling to find another job, his wife lands a high paying position at an advertising agency.

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: Joe Dirt is a janitor with a mullet, acid-washed jeans, and a dream -- to find the parents he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was a belligerent, trailer park-raised kid. Now, the irrepressibly optimistic Joe hits the road in search of his folks.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful (1987)
programme.desc: In this story from legendary filmmaker John Hughes, Keith, Watts and Amanda prove that you've got to risk a broken heart in order to find your one true love. This unforgettable romantic comedy has laughs, romance and is truly Some Kind of Wonderful.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: JR, a teenage criminal, is locked up for a minor crime and forced to adapt to the harsh realities of prison life. Brendan Lynch (Ewan McGregor), one of Australia's most notorious criminals, offers JR protection, but it comes with a price.

programme.title: Coherence
programme.desc: In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: Lester's life is far from perfect. As he makes a few changes in his life, the freer and the happier he gets. However, Lester is about to learn that the ultimate freedom comes at a price.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: When high school senior Tripp discovers a gas-guzzling creature named Creech, the unlikely duo team up for a fun-filled, hilarious and heartfelt adventure in a real-life super-powered Monster Truck to reunite Creech with his family.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling book series comes a fantasy adventure that reveals the unseen world all around us.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Still Smokin
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong fly to Amsterdam for a film festival. Soon after, they take Dolly Parton and Burt Reynolds' place in a limo, leading them to a press conference and a music performance. They throw in some sketches as well.

programme.title: Yellowbeard
programme.desc: A 17th-century pirate in search of treasure. He's accompanied by his son, who has the location of the treasure tattooed on his head. It is a parody on the pirate movies of earlier days.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle, where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Fire In The Sky
programme.desc: In 1975, logger Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) and his co-workers discovered a hovering UFO. Walton's pals fled, but Walton was not so fortunate. Whisked aboard the strange craft, he was subjected to a painful, unearthly medical study.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Gang Related

programme.title: Yours, Mine and Ours

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Peter Ustinov won an Oscar for Best Supporting Actor in this lighthearted thriller about five thieves (including Melina Mercouri, Maximilian Schell and Robert Morley) who undertake an absolutely impossible grand theft in Istanbul.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Operation Condor II: The Armour Of The Gods
programme.desc: Jackie Chan is a fortune hunter whose ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil cult! Things kick into high gear when her fiancée, an old friend of Jackie’s, asks him for help in securing the kidnappers’ lone demand: the priceless Armor of The Gods!

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: Jackie Chan plays a shrewd cop who goes undercover with a team of mercenaries when a man he put away two years before commits a murder. The film features the great Sammo Hung as well as the terrific Tony Leung Ka Fai.

programme.title: Supercop (1996)
programme.desc: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel is an unstoppable cop who, with the help of his bumbling partner, delivers some big-city justice in a small, quiet town.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: The Soloist
programme.desc: A Los Angeles newspaper reporter discovers a brilliant and distracted street musician, with unsinkable passion, and a unique friendship and bond transforms both their lives.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff

programme.title: Brimstone

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Ruins

programme.title: The Ring

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: A diabolical Mr. Reed (Hugh Grant) ensnares two young missionaries in his terrifying game of cat-and-mouse when they knock on the wrong door and are forced to prove their faith.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: A diabolical Mr. Reed (Hugh Grant) ensnares two young missionaries in his terrifying game of cat-and-mouse when they knock on the wrong door and are forced to prove their faith.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: The year is 1972, and Betsy Jobs and Arlene Lorenzo just want to have a good time. But during a class field trip to the White House, they cluelessly wander into a behind-closed-doors, top-secret shredding session. Rating: PG-13

programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: As a couple welcomes a newborn baby into their home, a demonic presence begins terrorizing them, tearing apart their perfect world and turning it into an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: Katie disappeared with her nephew, Hunter, and there were no survivors. Five years later, she's returned with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims with her demonic rage in a quiet neighborhood.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
programme.desc: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Silent Hill
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling horror action game, Silent Hill stars Radha Mitchell (Man on Fire) as Rose, a desperate mother who takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. Rating: R

programme.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
programme.desc: On the eve of her 18th birthday, plagued by terrifying nightmares and her father's disappearance, Heather discovers she is not who she thinks she is. The revelation leads her deep into a demonic world that threatens to trap her in Silent Hill forever.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Crime Story [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A Special Agent is assigned to protect a wealthy business magnate. However, when the businessman is kidnapped in a daring ambush, he teams up with a seasoned detective to crack the case. But soon he discovers the case isn't that simple.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Simmy Tong is an ordinary cabbie-turned-chauffeur who slips into a 2-billion-dollar, super-spy suit and inadvertently becomes a dashing secret agent.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus grow attached to the baby they kidnapped for their landlord, which leads to complications in handing the him over.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Cameron instantly falls for the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Widows
programme.desc: When four armed robbers are killed, their widows take fate into their own hands.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Still Smokin
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong fly to Amsterdam for a film festival. Soon after, they take Dolly Parton and Burt Reynolds' place in a limo, leading them to a press conference and a music performance. They throw in some sketches as well.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction
programme.desc: Jessica Biel, James Van Der Beek, and Ian Somerhalder bring life and laughter to this honest, edgy look at social and sexual relationships at college.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the town is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: A wealthy woman hires a carpenter to work on her yacht. When the carpenter is left unpaid, Joanna, sets sail. The following day, Joanna's fished out of the sea after falling overboard and diagnosed with amnesia.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Crocodile Dundee returns in this hilarious third installment of the beloved film series. After Mick's girlfriend, Sue, is assigned to the L.A. bureau of her father's newspaper, Mick, Sue, and their son Mikey head to Hollywood.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: When a power-crazed despot schemes to buy California from Mexico, it takes two Zorros--the legendary Don Diego de la Vega and his chosen successor Alejandro Murrieta, a dashing bandit-turned-hero-- to defeat the tyrant's unscrupulous plans.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Harlem Nights

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Dreamgirls

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus grow attached to the baby they kidnapped for their landlord, which leads to complications in handing the him over.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Jackie Chan stars in this family action-comedy which centers on a man (Chan) who is called to baby-sit his neighbor's children and winds up having to fight off secret agents after one of the kids inadvertently downloads a secret code.

programme.title: Little Big Soldier
programme.desc: An old soldier captures a young general after a battle in China and takes him on a long journey to collect a reward.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz

programme.title: Heartbreakers

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful (1987)
programme.desc: In this story from legendary filmmaker John Hughes, Keith, Watts and Amanda prove that you've got to risk a broken heart in order to find your one true love. This unforgettable romantic comedy has laughs, romance and is truly Some Kind of Wonderful.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling book series comes a fantasy adventure that reveals the unseen world all around us.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction
programme.desc: Jessica Biel, James Van Der Beek, and Ian Somerhalder bring life and laughter to this honest, edgy look at social and sexual relationships at college.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction
programme.desc: Jessica Biel, James Van Der Beek, and Ian Somerhalder bring life and laughter to this honest, edgy look at social and sexual relationships at college.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the town is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: The activity is back and has claimed a new victim. Jesse has been hearing horrifying sounds from his neighbor’s apartment, but when he sets out to uncover their source, he encounters an ancient evil that won’t rest until it’s claimed his soul.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: A wealthy woman hires a carpenter to work on her yacht. When the carpenter is left unpaid, Joanna, sets sail. The following day, Joanna's fished out of the sea after falling overboard and diagnosed with amnesia.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Better Off Dead
programme.desc: In this essential 80s classic, Lane (John Cusack, HIGH FIDELITY) decides that suicide is the answer after his girlfriend ditches him for a boorish ski jock. However, his increasingly inept attempts bring him only more agony, not to mention embarrassment.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Crocodile Dundee returns in this hilarious third installment of the beloved film series. After Mick's girlfriend, Sue, is assigned to the L.A. bureau of her father's newspaper, Mick, Sue, and their son Mikey head to Hollywood.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: An unhappy dentist in Montreal gets a new neighbor, Jimmy 'The Tulip' Teduski, a former mob hitman turned informant with a price on his head.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: When a power-crazed despot schemes to buy California from Mexico, it takes two Zorros--the legendary Don Diego de la Vega and his chosen successor Alejandro Murrieta, a dashing bandit-turned-hero-- to defeat the tyrant's unscrupulous plans.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: April Fool's Day

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Downhill Racer
programme.desc: An ambitious American Skier gains a place on the team competing in Europe.

programme.title: Brian's Song
programme.desc: Based on the real-life relationship between teammates Brian Piccolo and Gale Sayers, the bond is established when Piccolo discovers that he is dying.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Overlord

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Eine neue Klasse von hundert Universitätsstudenten stürmt die Burg. Zuerst müssen sie jedoch den Schildkrötenweg, die Malzeit und den Felsenkanal überstehen. Wird einer von ihnen den Abschluss schaffen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert neue Kandidaten stellen sich den brandneuen wippenden Dominos, dem schwingenden Plankengang und dem verrückten Torwandrennen, bevor sie die Burg stürmen können. Es ist nass, es ist rutschig, es ist Takeshi Castle.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert neue Kämpfer wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch wer kann das Bowlingspiel, die Rutschwand und die Hängebrücke überwinden?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert mutige Kandidaten treten an, um Takeshis Burg zu stürmen. Zuerst müssen sie aber Wasser, Schlamm und viele andere unschöne Dinge überwinden. Nur die Stärksten können es schaffen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Es ist schlammig und verrückt, es ist Takeshis Castle. Und es ist eine neue staffel Hundert Kandidaten stellen sich den rutschigen Trittsteinen und dem bekloppten Torwandrennen, bevor sie die Burg stürmen. Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert Kandidaten werden versuchen, Takeshis Burg zu stürmen. Auf der schwingenden Hängebrücke müssen sie zeigen, ob sie die Leibgarde besiegen können. Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während brandneue Kandidaten sich auf den Weg zur Burg machen. Macht euch bereit für Ausrutscher, Stolperer und Stürze auf der Rutschwand und auf der Rollbahn. Werden sie es bis zum Finalspiel schaffen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Neue Kandidaten stellen sich dem schlammigen Fußballfieber und rutschen hin und her bei Malzeit, um sich einen Platz im Finalspiel auf der Burg zu sichern. Wer schafft es, und wer bleibt im Schlamm stecken? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Die Krieger sind bereit fürs epische Tauziehen, doch eine andere Gruppe versucht noch, zur Burg zu gelangen. Ihnen stehen das Frühstück und das Torwandrennen bevor. Wer schafft es zum Finalspiel? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand

programme.title: Cheers: Die beste Kellnerin von Boston

programme.title: Cheers: Alles Glückssache

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Goldketten
programme.desc: Chris kann gerade noch verhindern, dass Vanessa ihre Goldkette geraubt wird. Als Entschädigung für den entgangenen Raubzug verlangt der Kleinkriminelle Malvo eine Goldkette unter Androhung von Schlägen.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst DJs
programme.desc: Chris hottet gerade auf einer Party ab, als man plötzlich den DJ verhaftet. Kurz entschlossen übernimmt Chris die Plattenspieler und heizt der Menge so gut ein, dass man ihn fürs Wochenende auf einer neuen Party engagiert.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Baseball
programme.desc: Chris bekommt von seinem Onkel Michael zwei Tickets für ein Baseball-Spiel geschenkt. Dummerweise hat er Tasha versprochen, mit ihr am selben Tag ins Kino zu gehen.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Sportwetten
programme.desc: Chris ist in der Lage, die Spiele der Basketball-Liga zu analysieren. Seine Tipps sind immer richtig. Bald darauf spricht sich überall rum, dass Chris das richtige Händchen für das Glücksspiel hat und man leicht Geld verdienen kann.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst die sieben Wörter
programme.desc: Durch Zufall bekommt Chris mit, dass seine Eltern gelegentlich die obszönen Platten eines Comedians anhören. Heimlich hört er sich die Platten selbst an und erzählt die schmutzigen Witze in der Schule weiter.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Mathe
programme.desc: Pizza bis zum Abwinken. Dieser verlockende Preis winkt der Gewinnerklasse beim jährlichen Mathewettbewerb. Um nicht als Versager vor seiner Klasse dazustehen, nimmt Chris Nachhilfeunterricht bei seiner Großmutter.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den letzten Schultag
programme.desc: In der letzen Schulwoche vor den Ferien zieht Chris das traurige Fazit, dass im abgelaufenen Jahr nichts so gekommen ist, wie er es wollte. Er überlegt sich, wie er noch zu einem Erfolgserlebnis kommen kann.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den Beratungslehrer
programme.desc: Am Ende des vergangenen Schuljahres musste Chris einen Test ablegen, den er allerdings nicht ernst genommen hat, was sich nun rächt: Der Beratungslehrer Mr. Abbott ruft Chris zu sich und redet ihm ein, dass aus ihm nichts werden wird.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Prügeleien
programme.desc: Chris wartet wie immer auf seine tägliche Abreibung durch Caruso, doch diesmal ist alles anders. Der neue Schüler Bernard Yao stellt sich als fieser Schläger heraus, der es mit Caruso aufnehmen kann.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Autofahren
programme.desc: Julius lässt Chris das Auto auf der Straße umparken - dieser nimmt die Erlaubnis jedoch als Anlass, einen Abstecher in die Schule zu machen. Dort sind die Mädels hin und weg von dem coolen Chris.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Goldlawine I
programme.desc: Dieter fällt auf einen Betrüger herein, der ihm die Chancen auf einen Millionengewinn verkauft. Er vergisst auch nicht die Freunde vom Dackelclub, die mit je 500 Mark an dem Spiel teilnehmen und versetzt seine ganze Familie in einen Kaufrausch...

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Goldlawine II
programme.desc: Carmen schmort unter ihrem Turbobräuner und Lisbeth genießt die neue Couchgarnitur. In der Bank lässt Dieter seiner neureichen Überheblichkeit freien Lauf. Doch aus dem erhofften Geldsegen wird schließlich doch nichts...

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Erbtante
programme.desc: Rüde weist Dieter eine ältere Dame zurecht, die sich auch als Besucherin an die Hausordnung zu halten hat! Dummerweise handelt es sich bei der Dame um Lisbeths Erbtante. Jetzt muss er sich mächtig ins Zeug legen, um die drohende Enterbung zu verhindern.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Der böse Nachbar
programme.desc: Wieder hat Nachbar Makielski sein Auto falsch geparkt! Hausmeister Krause reagiert mit einem bösen Drohschreiben. Was er nicht wusste: Makielski ist der neue Vertreter der Eigentümerversammlung und damit sein Vorgesetzter…

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Notoperation
programme.desc: Dieter erzählt seinen Dackelfreunden, dass Carmen nun Filmkarriere machen wird und Szenen in seiner Wohnung gedreht werden. Der Verein sagt sich als Besuch an und die Dackel sollen ins TV. Jedoch handelt es sich evtl. doch nicht um eine Krankenhaus-Serie!

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Ratte
programme.desc: Tommies neues Haustier entlockt Lisbeth und Carmen Schreckensschreie: Der Bengel hat eine Ratte ins Haus geschleppt! Dieter schreitet sofort zur Tat und stellt eine Rattenfalle auf. Doch statt des Nagetiers verfängt sich Nachbar Makielski in der Falle ...

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Das Kommando-Unternehmen
programme.desc: Dieter entdeckt eine unerlaubte Anpflanzung im Hof. Er ist überzeugt, dass die Wohngemeinschaft Marihuana angebaut hat. Er trommelt den Dackelclub zusammen, um den Dealern das Handwerk zu legen, während seine Kinder mit den Drogen Geld machen wollen.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Der Sittenstrolch
programme.desc: Ein Exhibitionist ist in der Nähe der Siedlung gesichtet worden. Sofort leitet Dieter die Fahndung ein und benutzt seinen Freund Herbert als Lockvogel in Lisbeths Klamotten. Doch wie immer kommt wieder alles ganz anders als geplant…

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Der Einbruch
programme.desc: Dieter fürchtet, dass die Siedlung bald von Einbrüchen heimgesucht wird, doch Herr Makielski hält seine Angst für übertrieben. Um ihn von der Notwendigkeit einer Alarmanlage zu überzeugen, brechen Dieter und Herbert in Makielskis Wohnung ein.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Der Hochzeitstag
programme.desc: Dieter will sein Dackeljubiläum groß feiern und seine Freunde zu einem Fest nach Hause einladen. Überrascht und gerührt verfolgt Lisbeth die Vorbereitungen zur Feier - in dem irrigen Glauben, Dieter hätte an ihren Hochzeitstag gedacht!

programme.title: Frasier: Psycho
programme.desc: Eine therapeutischen Gemeinschaftspraxis von Frasier und Niles bringt das Schlimmste in ihrer Beziehung zum Vorschein.

programme.title: Die fliegenden Ärzte

programme.title: Die fliegenden Ärzte

programme.title: Die fliegenden Ärzte

programme.title: Die fliegenden Ärzte
programme.desc: Die dreijährige Sophie stürzt in einen Minenschacht. Luke, Jack und die "Flying Doctors" bemühen sich verzweifelt, Sophie mit einem Seil herauszuziehen, doch die Aktion scheitert. Darauf versuchen die Männer, das Mädchen auszugraben…

programme.title: Die fliegenden Ärzte

programme.title: Outer Limits – Die unbekannte Dimension

programme.title: Outer Limits – Die unbekannte Dimension

programme.title: Raumschiff Enterprise

programme.title: Call my Agent

programme.desc: Ihre Arbeit ist für sie mehr als ein Beruf, gehört zu den gefährlichsten der Welt und bringt doch nur wenig Geld ein. Dennoch möchte keiner etwas anderes machen - die Baumkletterer von Kalifornien.

programme.title: Das Korallendreieck: Ein tiefes Geheimnis

programme.title: Tierarztgeschichten: Folge 6

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Mork trifft Peter Pan
programme.desc: Da Mindy bedrückt ist, weil sie kein Stipendium bekommen hat, und Mork sie unbedingt aufheitern will, bringt er einen Freund mit nach Hause, der behauptet, der echte Peter Pan zu sein – und Fliegen ist nur eines seiner vielen magischen Talente.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Operation Schönheit
programme.desc: Als Mindy Mork die Idee in den Kopf setzt, dass jeder etwas an sich verbessern kann, ist er plötzlich auf Facelifting fixiert und eilt in seiner einzigartigen urkomischen Art zu einem plastischen Chirurgen, um „ein bisschen was machen zu lassen“.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Mork rollt ins Ziel
programme.desc: Im größten und lustigsten Skating-Marathon aller Zeiten steht Mork das allererste Mal auf Rollerskates und tritt gegen einen betrügerischen Skater-Champion an, um die Kindertagesstätte, in der er arbeitet, vor der Zerstörung zu retten.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Gib dem Affen Zucker
programme.desc: Mork verwandelt die Wohnung, die er mit Mindy teilt, in ein wahnwitziges Versteck für einen jungen Schimpansen, den er aus dem Zoo von Boulder entführt, weil er fälschlicherweise glaubt, dass die Mutter des Tieres entführt wurde.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Mork heiratet Mindy
programme.desc: Mindy ist die schöne Braut und Mork der ulkige Bräutigam – der wohl nicht in seinen Smoking passen wird, wenn er Orson nicht davon überzeugen kann, der Ehe zuzustimmen und seine Verwandlung in einen englischen Schäferhund rückgängig zu machen.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Der Anti-Mork
programme.desc: Mork bekommt Konkurrenz für seinen Job als offizieller Erdbeobachter, als sein Held vom Ork, der aalglatte und charmante Xerko, zur Erde gebeamt wird und Mork zu einem unerhörten Wettbewerb um das Recht herausfordert, von der Erde an Ork zu berichten.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Mork, der Witzbold
programme.desc: Der kosmische Schabernack von Raumfahrer Mork geht so weit, dass er Mindy überrascht, indem er ihren Jeep in ihrem Wohnzimmer direkt über Mr. Bickleys Wohnung zusammenbaut – mit katastrophalen Folgen.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Schönes Wetter heute
programme.desc: Mindy bekommt einen Job bei einem kleinen Fernsehsender und liefert ein desaströses Debüt vor der Kamera ab, doch dann eilt Mork mit seiner abgefahrenen, Ork-mäßigen Darbietung der Abendnachrichten zur tumultartigen Rettung.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Unter Brüdern
programme.desc: Als Mindy eine von Morks Gourmet-Köstlichkeiten isst, verwandelt sie sich in eine schrullige Orkanerin, die bei ihrem Familientreffen Aufregung verbreitet und ihrem aufgeblasenen Onkel Dave einen bizarren Abend bereitet, den er nicht vergessen wird.

programme.title: Mork vom Ork: Mork und der Pennerblues
programme.desc: Mork veranstaltet seinen eigenen TV-Spendenmarathon, um Mindy beim Sammeln von Spendengeldern für wohltätige Zwecke zu helfen, ist dabei aber so tollpatschig und erfolglos, dass er betteln gehen muss, um das benötigte Geld aufzutreiben.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Entführt
programme.desc: Reichtum hat seine Vorteile, birgt aber auch Risiken. Eine davon ist die Entführung. Keine Tortur ist für eine Familie entsetzlicher als die Entführung des eigenen Kindes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Der Preis der Habgier
programme.desc: Als eine Diebesbande einen Geldtresor in Los Angeles überfällt, droht sie jeden zu töten, der sich widersetzt. Der gewalttätige Überfall gilt als der größte Raub in der Geschichte der USA, und ein Stück Plastik stellt den einzigen Beweis dar.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Kleinstadt-Terror
programme.desc: In einer kleinen Gemeinde in Ohio verschwinden eine ältere Frau und ein Teenager. Da beide innerhalb von Stunden verschwinden, glaubt die Polizei an einen Zusammenhang. Doch was verbindet die Opfer?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Tödliches Geheimnis
programme.desc: Zwei kleine Jungen als die einzigen Zeugen des Mordes an ihrer Mutter. Das schreckliche Verbrechen scheint unmotiviert, sinnlos und zufällig.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Andromeda ist zum Check im Trockendock. Tyr nutzt die Zeit und begibt sich auf die Suche nach Überlebenden seiner Art. Die restliche Crew ist mit der Stapellaufung der Hector, des neuesten Kriegsschiffs des Commonwealth, zu Gange.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Kriegsministerin informiert Dylan, dass Gerüchte darüber kursieren, die Nietzscheaner hätten sich dem Commonwealth angeschlossen. Dylan bleibt skeptisch. Und zu Recht, wie sich bald zeigt. Sechs Nietzscheaner nehmen die Crew als Geiseln.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Auf einer Reparaturstation, die ein Mann namens Citizen Eight leitet, wird die Andromeda generalüberholt. Dort gibt es einen Seher, der die Zukunft voraussagt. Doch Dylan findet bald heraus, dass dabei nicht alles mit rechten Dingen zugeht.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Triumvir Tri-Lorn erteilt Dylan den Auftrag einen Mond zu zerstören, auf dem sich der größenwahnsinnige Forscher Kroton aufhalten soll. Gemeinsam mit Beka, Rommie und Harper fliegt Dylan an Bord der Maru zur Oberfläche des Mondes.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Auf einem Schiff entdecken Dylan, Beka und Trance die Opfer eines Angriffs der Nietzscheaner. Die haben scheinbar durch eine neuartige Waffe, die in den Händen des Nietzscheaners Calleb vermutet wird, irreparablen geistigen Schaden erlitten.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Andromeda-Crew erreicht der Notruf eines Gefangenentransporters. Auf dem Transporter wird ihr ehemaliges Crewmitglied Tyr Anasazi gefangen gehalten. Er hat einst Verrat am Commonwealth begangen, weshalb ihm alle bis auf Beka misstrauen.

programme.title: Bionic Woman
programme.desc: Jaime und Max, der weltweit erste bionische Hund, geraten in der Sierra Nevada in einen gigantischen Waldbrand. Um rechtzeitig vor den alles verschlingenden Flammen in Sicherheit zu fliehen, muss das eingespielte Duo all seine Kräfte bündeln.

programme.title: Bionic Woman
programme.desc: Der Sohn eines verrückten Wissenschaftlers reaktiviert dessen Armee der Roboter-Girls.

programme.title: Bionic Woman
programme.desc: Der Sohn eines verrückten Wissenschaftlers verhandelt mit Jaime, Oscar und Dr. Wells über das Lösegeld für eine gefährliche Energiewaffe im Erdorbit. Die Bedrohung aus dem Weltraum zwingt die Gruppe zu schwierigen Verhandlungen mit ihm.

programme.title: Bionic Woman
programme.desc: Jaime versucht, das Leben eines OSI-Wissenschaftlers zu retten, der Rodeo-Meister werden möchte.

programme.title: The Bionic Woman
programme.desc: Jaime enthüllt OSI-Geheimnisse und gefährdet Oscars Leben, nachdem er unter Drogen gesetzt wurde.

programme.title: The Bionic Woman
programme.desc: Der Sohn eines Ostblock-Überläufers scheitert an seiner Rettung, als er sich in Jaime verliebt.

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Jeanne begegnet einem mysteriösen Mann, der sie gut zu kennen scheint. Doch woher? Zur gleichen Zeit bereitet sich die Crew der Nausicäa auf die Landung auf dem Mars vor. Noch wissen sie allerdings nicht, dass ihnen etwas vorenthalten wurde...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Nachdem die Besatzung auf dem Mars gelandet ist, folgt sie Jeannes Spur. Simon und Alessandra führen die Crew durch einen mysteriösen Tempel auf dem roten Planeten. Dort angekommen, kommt die Wahrheit über eines der Besatzungsmitglieder ans Licht ...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Komarov offenbart gegenüber Jeanne, dass Goldstein sie nicht belogen hat. Derweil reist die Besatzung durch ein mysteriöses Portal inmitten der marsianischen Kraterlandschaft. Auf der anderen Seite angekommen, wartet eine Entscheidung auf sie...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Peter ist berührt von seinem Treffen mit Sam und begreift schließlich, dass dieser die Wahrheit sagt. Im Vertrauen verrät ihm Samuel ein letztes Geheimnis. Diese Enthüllung führt Peter zu einer Untersuchung, die er sich nicht hätte vorstellen können...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Samuel Becker ist seit seiner Rückkehr zur Erde ein Gefangener und wiederholt immer wieder die gleiche Geschichte: Er ist vom Mars zurückgekehrt. Jedoch glaubt ihm niemand, da noch nie jemand auf dem Mars war...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Peter kommt mit jedem Mitglied der besagten Marsmission in Kontakt. Er findet heraus, dass Jeanne der Schlüssel zum Geheimnis ist. Sie bittet eine italienische Psychologin um Hilfe...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Peter konfrontiert Adrian mit dem Attentat, dessen Opfer er zu sein glaubt. Alice geht zu ihrem Vater, um ihn über ein Geheimnis voller Konsequenzen zu befragen...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Nach zehn Monaten im All steht der Tag der Landung auf dem roten Planeten kurz bevor. Doch dann müssen Meyer und seine europäische Crew feststellen, dass die Amerikaner ihnen mit neuer Technologie zuvorgekommen und bereits auf dem Mars gelandet sind.

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Der Zentralcomputer der Odysseus ist zerstört und Yann hat kaum Hoffnung, dass er den Schaden wieder beheben kann. Gramat, Jeanne und Eva entscheiden daraufhin, sich auf den Weg zu den Amerikanern zu machen. Aber stattdessen entdecken sie etwas anderes...

programme.title: Missions
programme.desc: Die Besatzungsmitglieder sind immer noch sprachlos ob der wahren Identität des Überlebenden. Doch plötzlich verschwindet er über Nacht. Entgegen der Widersprüche der anderen Crewmitglieder beschließt Gramat, sich auf den Weg zu machen und ihn zu suchen.

programme.title: Inseln der Zukunft: Madeira - Kampf um Wasser und Strom
programme.desc: Auf der atemberaubend schönen Ferieninsel Madeira im Atlantik haben Ingenieure einen riesigen Speicher für Windenergie gebaut. Dadurch kann umweltfreundlicher Öko-Strom auch dann erzeugt werden, wenn kein Wind weht.

programme.title: Inseln der Zukunft: Orkney - Die blaue Revolution
programme.desc: Vielleicht wird Orkney für die Wellen- und Gezeitenstromgewinnung einmal das sein, was das Silicon Valley für die Computerindustrie war: Der Ort, wo alles begann. Die Wiege der blauen Energierevolution. Eine Insel der Zukunft.

programme.title: Inseln der Zukunft: Samsø - Die Gemeinschaft des Stroms
programme.desc: Am Anfang stand ein Wettbewerb: 1997 suchte Dänemark nach einem Ort, der beweisen sollte, dass 100%ige Stromversorgung mit erneuerbaren Energien möglich ist. Anfangs reagierten die Bewohner der Insel Samsø skeptisch. Doch dann kam alles anders.

programme.title: Wasser ist Zukunft: Andalusiens geheimer Schatz
programme.desc: Der Süden Spaniens ist geprägt durch Meer und Sonne. Ausgerechnet hier, wo es kaum Wasser gibt, wird Gemüse für ganz Europa angebaut. Der Wasserverbrauch ist enorm. Wird das Wasser reichen, für die Landwirtschaft und für die Natur Andalusiens?

programme.title: Wasser ist Zukunft: Der Colorado - Ein Fluss sucht seine Mündung
programme.desc: Der Colorado versorgt unzählige Menschen mit Wasser. Dafür hat man ihn gebändigt. Er erreicht das Meer nicht mehr, sondern versickert. Wie kann es gelingen, dass er eines Tages wieder sein Ziel erreicht und das trockene Delta zu neuem Leben erwacht?
